notes.title: Check Out the New Level in Our Demo!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Got some news - we’ve dropped a new level into our demo!

We’ve put in some new features bug fixes and even a few unlockables. Plus, it looks awesome (if we do say so ourselves 😉).

Give it a whirl and tell us what you think. Your feedback’s gold to us and it helps a ton as we polish up for the full release.

So, what are you waiting for? Update your demo, dive in, and let’s get this party started!

Happy gaming!

notes.title: Development News.
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, and thanks for stopping by!

We wanted to take a few minutes and show some behind the scenes and in-development screenshots.

We have a few comic panels from our artist Ken that we're finishing up we still have voice lines to record and some polish to do but they're absolutely beautiful!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36425812/d6b647cf8490fcfe66ad4f29348aa3b3e5122b8d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36425812/ffc4d86b67de18c4f5cf7c82965ebfc5a2f46267.png[/img]


And here's another one that's still early in the sketching phase, but thought everyone would enjoy a look:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36425812/9e81f270dadf159abb420aed8505009d56ee4bc0.jpg[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36425812/cf262b179da3c2ddc4bf7866630fb4fe0f750cfb.png[/img]

And lastly a small sample of one of the areas that L10 be travelling through!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36425812/0f105808b7b2226ad2d6b0851eeee3fbce17c950.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36425812/22038c6a826a44220872d9c78208c9b082b2d087.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36425812/c5fd22d6b3ecfc2af14241e70c544573be5d2596.png[/img]

Currently we're finishing basic layout for the last 2 levels, recording the remaining voice lines as well as a 
fair amount of planning.

Despite numerous challenges the game is progressing very well, and we couldn't be more excited to get it out there for everyone!

Thanks so much for reading, and we hope you enjoyed the preview!

notes.title: Latest development update
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]

We wanted to give an update on what we're working on, and also a sneak peek at whats coming for the game.

Right now we're working on cut-scenes, originally we wanted to have In-engine only, but being big fans of comics both digital and print we thought it would be lots of fun to include some in O.M.S.

We got right to work on it, and sent off a storyboard to a comic panel artist, and got back some sketches which looked fantastic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36425812/43cdf954564ccebd464f22a04899a98b46287d23.png[/img]
 
So we gave the go-ahead to finish inking.

The finished comic scenes will be fully voiced and the panels will be partially animated, have sound effects and.... look like this!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36425812/2d081c0ff796bb8e28caae27a493288cb4bfd2f8.png[/img]

Couldn't be more excited about the project, its has slowed down a bit because of everything happening in the world but it's still moving forward, we removed the end of year release date as some have noticed, but we hope everyone looks forward to the demo that should be ready sometime in the coming months!

Be safe and stay healthy everyone.

[i]-Team Kikohin[/i]
